name: todue-relay-demo-video
description: The ToDue Relay demo video, built with Remotion from the real pipeline's output on fake emails.

scripts.render: remotion render TodueDemo out/todue-demo-1x.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/todue-demo-1x.mp4 -filter:v setpts=PTS/1.25 -r 30 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 18 -movflags +faststart out/todue-demo.mp4
